sections.Profile:
The Australian bushranger Ned Kelly gets his own game in Vector Pinball's Aussie Icon series. The player spells R-E-B-E-L in the top lanes for a two-ball skill-shot multiball, clears the Target Practice drop targets to lock balls for three-ball Bush Ranger multiball, and hits the blacksmith's A-R-M-O-R targets to spell N-E-D-K-E-L-L-Y and start the four-ball Kelly Gang multiball.
